Name: Simon Says
Author: Home Deck
Description: Turn a page of keys into a pattern-memory game. Watch the keys light up in sequence, then repeat it back — get it right and the sequence grows by one, get it wrong and it starts over. Every few rounds earns a little celebration.

Actions.Name: Pad
Actions.Tooltip: One pad in the pattern-memory game. Place it on every key of a folder page and watch the sequence play across all of them.
